findings.quote: Reducing the number of lanes on Burnhamthorpe Road would result in significantly more congestion, delays and vehicle queuing and may, in turn, divert motorists to adjoining local roadways, which are not designed to accommodate this traffic.

findings.item_title: This item was considered by Toronto and East York Community Council on February 20, 2025. It is being forwarded to City Council without recommendations. It will be considered by City Council on March 26 and 27, 2025.
